scenes.title: Bored in the Pasture
scenes.english_text: A Shepherd Boy tended his master's sheep near a dark forest not far from the village. Soon he found life in the pasture very dull. All he could do to amuse himself was to talk to his dog or play on his shepherd's pipe.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha bibi-atan ki'ik ida ne'ebé hein nia na'i nia bibi-malae sira iha du'ut fatin, besik ai-laran metan ne'ebé la dook husi knua. Maibé lakteu nia sente baruk tebes ho moris iha ne'e. Nia bele ko'alia de'it ho nia asu ka toka flauta hodi halimar.
scenes.scene_summary: A young shepherd boy sitting bored on a grassy hill near a dark forest, surrounded by grazing sheep, playing a wooden flute with his loyal dog lying beside him.

scenes.title: The First False Alarm
scenes.english_text: One day, sitting near the quiet forest, he thought of a trick to amuse himself. His master had told him to call for help if a wolf attacked, and the villagers would drive it away. So, even though there was no wolf, he ran toward the village shouting at the top of his voice, "Wolf! Wolf!"
scenes.tetum_translation: Loron ida, bainhira tuur haree bibi-malae sira, nia hetan ideia di'ak ida hodi halimar. Nia na'i dehan tiha ona ba nia katak, se lobu ataka bibi sira, nia tenke bolu ajuda husi ema knua nian. Nune'e, maski la haree lobu ida, nia halai ba knua hodi hakilar ho lian boot: "Lobu! Lobu mai ona!"
scenes.scene_summary: The shepherd boy running excitedly down the hill towards the village, pretending to be frightened and yelling for help while waving his arms.

scenes.title: The Villagers Fooled
scenes.english_text: The villagers dropped their work and ran to help him. But when they arrived, they found the boy laughing at the trick he had played. A few days later, the boy shouted "Wolf! Wolf!" again, and the villagers ran to help, only to be fooled a second time.
scenes.tetum_translation: Ema knua nian rona tiha nia hakilar, sira husik sira-nia servisu hodi halai lalais mai tulun nia. Maibé kuandu sira to'o iha ne'eba, sira haree bibi-atan ne'e hamnasa tebes tanba bosok tiha sira. Hafoin loron balu liu tiha, nia hakilar fali, "Lobu! Lobu!" no ema knua nian halai mai fali, maibé sira sai vitima bosok nian ba dala rua.
scenes.scene_summary: Out-of-breath villagers holding farm tools looking confused and angry, while the mischievous shepherd boy rolls on the grass laughing hysterically.

scenes.title: The Real Wolf Appears
scenes.english_text: Then one evening, as the sun was setting behind the forest, a real wolf sprang from the underbrush and attacked the sheep. In terror, the boy ran toward the village shouting, "Wolf! Wolf!"
scenes.tetum_translation: Maibé iha lokraik ida, bainhira loron atu tun iha ai-laran kotuk, lobu boot ida mosu duni husi ai-huun laran no sobu bibi-malae sira. Bibi-atan ne'e ta'uk tebes no halai lalais ba knua hodi hakilar: "Lobu! Lobu mai duni ona!"
scenes.scene_summary: A dramatic golden sunset scene where a big, fierce wolf jumps out from dark bushes toward terrified sheep, as the shepherd boy runs away in genuine panic.

scenes.title: No One Believes Him
scenes.english_text: The villagers heard his cries, but they thought he was playing another trick. "He cannot fool us again," they said, and no one came to help. The wolf killed many sheep and slipped away back into the forest.
scenes.tetum_translation: Ema knua nian rona nia hakilar, maibé sira hanoin nia halimar fali ona. Sira dehan, "Nia la bele bosok ita ba dala tolu!" no la iha ema ida mak halai ba tulun nia. Lobu ne'e oho bibi-malae barak no halai lakon fali ba ai-laran.
scenes.scene_summary: Villagers in the village square ignoring the distant shouting and carrying on with their evening routines, unaware that a real wolf is attacking the flock.

scenes.title: The Sad Lesson
scenes.english_text: The boy lost his master's sheep and learned a painful lesson. Liars are not believed even when they speak the truth.
scenes.tetum_translation: Bibi-atan ki'ik ne'e lakon ninia bibi sira no aprende lição moruk ida: Ema ne'ebé gosta bosok, ema seluk sei la fiar tan nia, maski nia ko'alia lia-loos.
scenes.scene_summary: The shepherd boy crying alone in the darkening pasture at twilight, looking remorsefully at the empty hill where his sheep used to graze.
